_readme: Every relic in the game. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. id and displayName are always required. effect names a PrincesPalace.Domain.Content.RelicEffect value (case-insensitive) — RelicEntryResolver rejects an unknown name at build time rather than shipping a relic that silently does nothing. No two relics may resolve to the same effect: each one has to be its own reason to pick it. Relics carry no numeric fields (no cost, no plus, no stat block) — they are a fixed set of hand-tuned combat behaviours, each with its own case in FightController, not data-driven bonuses. There is no 'unlocked' gate yet: every relic here is always available to assign (see RelicLoadout, which is what actually limits who can carry which — one relic per character, one character per relic). iconPath is optional and points at Assets/_Project/Art/Items/Relics/Processed/ — SceneBuilder.LoadSprite leaves the slot blank with a console warning until that file actually exists, and RelicsController falls back to its flat accent-coloured circle in the meantime.

relics.description: Whenever this character attacks, they strike the same target a second time.
After casting, the next hit this character takes is reduced by half.
Killing an enemy grants this character another turn.
